snippet.title: Worms Battlegrounds Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Worms™ Battlegrounds is the biggest and best Worms™ game to date - more worms, larger landscapes, more dynamic water, more weapons and more customisation items than ever before!  Featuring beautiful high definition 3D visuals with new lighting effects, a new clan system, exciting additions to the single player experience, and more of everything a Worms fan could want!

Like Worms on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/WormsTeam17
Follow Team17 on Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/Team17Ltd
